chunks.title: About Ruslan
chunks.keywords: who kim haqqında about introduction tanış ruslan jabbarov cabbarov baku bakı validation model risk
chunks.text: Ruslan Jabbarov is a Model Validation & Credit Risk Analyst (Intern) and Data Science developer based in Baku, Azerbaijan. He is a Business Administration student at UNEC with a strong background in financial modeling, credit risk scoring, machine learning, and GenAI applications.

chunks.title: Education
chunks.keywords: education təhsil university universitet unec div academy study oxuyur degree bachelor
chunks.text: Ruslan is pursuing a Bachelor of Business Administration at UNEC (Sep 2023 – Present, GPA: 85/100). He also completed a comprehensive Data Science program at Div Academy in Baku (Oct 2025 – May 2026).

chunks.title: Model Risk & Validation Skills
chunks.keywords: model risk validation credit risk pd lgd ead ifrs 9 basel iii shap explainability backtesting calibration stability
chunks.text: Ruslan specializes in Model Risk & Validation concepts: Credit Risk parameters (PD/LGD/EAD), IFRS 9, Basel III guidelines, validation testing (discrimination, calibration, stability, backtesting), data quality checks, validation reporting, and SHAP explainability.

chunks.title: Machine Learning & Programming Skills
chunks.keywords: skills bacarıq machine learning ml python pandas numpy scikit-learn lightgbm xgboost postgresql sql git excel
chunks.text: Ruslan works extensively with Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost), SQL (PostgreSQL), statistics, and Git. His ML skills cover regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics.

chunks.title: Gen AI, LLM & NLP Skills
chunks.keywords: rag llm genai prompt engineering ai agents xlm-roberta transformers nlp langchain vector embeddings similarity chatbot
chunks.text: Ruslan builds AI applications using GenAI, Prompt Writing, RAG, and AI agents, alongside testing AI models for accuracy, hallucination, and bias. He has hands-on experience with transformer-based NLP models like XLM-ROBERTa.

chunks.title: Engineering and Tools
chunks.keywords: fastapi docker streamlit jupyter matplotlib seaborn plotly api supabase render deployment
chunks.text: Ruslan deploys production ML & RAG workflows using FastAPI, Docker, Streamlit, Supabase PostgreSQL, and Render. He uses Jupyter, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly for visualization and exploratory analysis.

chunks.title: Credit Risk Assessment System
chunks.keywords: credit risk loan default home credit lightgbm banking project layihə kredit scoring shap basel iii docker
chunks.text: Credit Risk Assessment System: Built a credit scoring model on 307,511 loan applications achieving AUC-ROC of 0.78 and Gini of 0.56. Engineered 72 features from 406 raw inputs, integrated a 3-tier decision rule with SHAP explanations following Basel III, and deployed it as a live app (FastAPI, Streamlit, Supabase PostgreSQL, Docker, Render). GitHub: ruslancabbarov/Home-Credit-Risk-Management.

chunks.title: Multilingual Text Classification (DataRace / MSİM)
chunks.keywords: multilingual nlp text classification datarace msim tf-idf xlm-roberta transformers azerbaijani russian english
chunks.text: Multilingual Text Classification: Built an ensemble of TF-IDF and XLM-ROBERTa for texts in Azerbaijani, Russian, and English for the DataRace / MSİM competition, achieving a public leaderboard score of ~0.9166.

chunks.title: Fraud Detection Microservice
chunks.keywords: fraud detection xgboost fast-api real-time scoring api recall transaction risk
chunks.text: Fraud Detection System: Developed an XGBoost model with AUC of 0.998. Feature engineering raised fraud recall to 96%. Deployed as a real-time scoring REST API built with FastAPI.

chunks.title: Employee Churn & California House Prices
chunks.keywords: employee churn random forest recall house prices lasso regression scikit-learn
chunks.text: Employee Churn Prediction: Random Forest model with 98% accuracy, tuned threshold to achieve 97% at-risk recall. California House Prices: Lasso regression with feature selection to prevent overfitting, identifying median income as the main driver.

chunks.title: Energy & AI Hackathon Preparation
chunks.keywords: energy enerji anomaly detection isolation forest socar ministry of energy hackathon hakaton
chunks.text: Preparing for the Energy & AI Hackathon (Ministry of Energy & SOCAR): Focuses on time-series energy anomaly detection (Isolation Forest, Z-score), consumption forecasting, and RAG-based AI recommendation systems.
